items.question: Which qualities or powers are included in this enumerated series?
premises: The verse lists kṣudhā as hunger.
The verse lists tṛṣṇā as thirst.
The verse lists nidrā as sleep.
The verse lists kāntiḥ as beauty.
The verse lists buddhiḥ as intellect.
The verse lists dyutiḥ as radiance.
The particle tathā connects these items.
items.inference: This verse enumerates hunger, thirst, sleep, beauty, intellect, and radiance as members of the series.
uncertainties: Whether these terms name personified powers or abstract qualities is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Hunger, thirst, and also sleep, beauty, intellect, and also radiance.
